{{Top|leg}}
'''Premiere''' was the title of the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garban]] and the [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Selection of the Jenet to fill the post was convoluted and difficult to understand for outsiders; nevertheless, the premier of Garban was always recognizable by his or her name. This individual was aided by a group of leaders known as the [[Council of 127]].<ref name="GG4b ">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>
